content.short: Landano is a decentralized land registration platform using NFT title deeds to secure property rights on Cardano.
content.description: Landano is an innovative decentralized application (dApp) leveraging the Cardano blockchain to provide immutable proof-of-fact ownership for land and property. By notarizing property deeds as NFTs, Landano creates a transparent and verifiable record that helps secure land rights in regions with underdeveloped legal infrastructure. The platform incorporates decentralized identity through Atala PRISM, ensuring that user data remains secure and sovereign. By providing legal proof of ownership, Landano empowers individuals to access essential financial services like bank accounts and credit.
content.meta: Landano uses Cardano NFT deeds to provide decentralized land registration and secure property rights. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
